alert.message: OpenClaw gateway is reachable by RPC on 127.0.0.1:18789, but systemd reports the gateway service inactive/dead and the installed service config is outdated/non-standard with an embedded token.
alert.action: Standardize gateway management: verify PM2 vs systemd ownership, then reinstall or clean up the systemd unit as recommended by openclaw doctor/openclaw gateway install --force.
